info.title: Skyline.DataMiner.SDM.Tools
info.description: Command-line tool for Skyline DataMiner SDM that assists with one-time code generation tasks, primarily generating GUIDs for DOM entity definitions and scaffolding initial entity structures.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate common code to store data in a DataMiner system

commands.name: DomMapper
commands.description: Generates DataMiner Object Model DOM mapper classes based on the SDM attributes in the source code.

options.name: --ouputPath
options.description: The folder where the mappings should be saved.

commands.name: Exposers
commands.description: Generates SDM exposer classes based on the [GenerateExposers] attribute in the source code.

options.name: --ouputPath
options.description: The folder where the exposers should be saved.

commands.name: Middleware
commands.description: Generates SDM middleware wrapper classes based on the [AllowSdmMiddleware] attribute in the source code.

options.name: --ouputPath
options.description: The folder where the middleware wrappers should be saved.

commands.name: Repository
commands.description: Generates repository classes for the specified storage type.

commands.name: DOM
commands.description: Generates DOM repository classes based on the [SdmDomStorage] attribute in the source code.

options.name: --ouputPath
options.description: The folder where the repositories should be saved.
